bonds_intro_1: Galibi ana kiran takardun bashi na gwamnati saka jari 'mara haɗari'.
bonds_intro_2: Bitcoin kuɗi ne na dijital da ke aiki ba tare da dogaro da gwamnatoci ba.
bonds_intro_3: Amma shin takardun bashi na gaske mara haɗari ne? Kuma yaya suke kwatankwanci da Bitcoin a matsayin mai ajiye daraja?
point_1_summary_1: Shaidu suna “mara haɗari” da suna kawai — hauhawar farashi, canjin ƙimar riba, da haɗarin gazawa duk suna lalata sakamako na gaske.
point_1_summary_2: Bitcoin yana da bambanci a bayyane, amma ba shi da haɗarin sashi a ɓoye.

point_7_summary_1: Shaidu sun dogara gabaɗaya akan gwamnatoci da ke biyan basussukansu. Idan gwamnati ta gaza ko ta rage bashinta ta hanyar hauhawar farashi, masu shaidun za su rasa.
